reconciliation_of_241_long_history_tasks.phase6_discrepancy_explanation: Phase 6 recorded 49 as the difference between 241 and the un-deduplicated partition sum (120+36+36=192). In the deduplicated development set, exactly 172 entities had pre-failure windows within [5100, 10800], while 69 entities had failures occurring after 12000s, generating only Normal windows during development. Exactly 0 unused failing tasks with >= 15 pre-failure bins exist.

canonical_isolation_audit.scheduler_retry_and_restart_handling: In Borg Trace 2011, retry attempts obtain distinct task_index values or execute sequentially. Each entity_id represents an isolated container execution. Post-failure steps are censored and excluded to prevent retrospective alerts from counting as early detection.

normal_candidate_cohort_audit.censorship_handling: Steps within 1800s of telemetry termination without a terminal event (FINISH=4) are labeled -1 (UNKNOWN) by TargetLabelGenerator and discarded by WindowGenerator(exclude_unknown=True).

label_boundaries.normal: time_to_failure > 1800.0s with >= 1800.0s follow-up or FINISH event -> y=0
label_boundaries.unknown: censored lookahead (< 1800s without FINISH) or post-failure step -> label -1 (excluded)

feature_causality_and_scaling_audit.feature_causality: Strictly trailing mathematical operators (shift, rolling, min_periods=1) per entity. Zero forward-looking features.
feature_causality_and_scaling_audit.confirmatory_scaling_protocol: Transform-only; zero parameters fitted on holdout data.

statistical_power_and_uncertainty_feasib.statistical_power_assessment: The proposed L=5 confirmatory cohort provides 141 independent failure episodes across 137 entities and 700 pre-failure windows (or 77 episodes across 75 entities in the strictly disjoint-job subset). This meets all requirements for non-degenerate entity-level cluster bootstrap uncertainty intervals, precision-recall AUC, and episode detection lead-time analysis.
